newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Pacific Capital (Holdings) unit Haddowe sets loan.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Capital (Holdings) unit Haddowe sets loan.

text.p: The following syndicated loan issue was announced by arranger Rabobank Hong Kong.
The borrower is a subsidiary of Pacific Capital (Holdings) Ltd, which is engaged in the property business in Hong Kong and China. Details are as follows:
BORROWER HADDOWE LTD GUARANTOR --
AMOUNT HK$475 MLN TYPE TERM LOAN
MARGIN H+250 MATURITY 5 YRS AVGE LIFE 4 YRS
PUTS NONE CALLS NONE LAUNCHED WEEK NOV 11
DRAWDOWN NA AVAIL 3 MTHS HOME CTRY HONG KONG
REPAYMENT SEMI-ANNUAL UNEQUAL INSTALMENTS AFTER 6 MONTHS'
GRACE PERIOD GOV LAW HONG KONG
REPLIES MID DEC.96
NOTES THE FACILITY IS SECURED BY A COMMERCIAL COMPLEX,
RETAIL AND CARPARKING SPACES. PROCEEDS WILL BE USED
TO REFINANCE EXISTING DEBTS AND FOR GENERAL WORKING
CAPITAL.
ARRANGER AND UNDERWRITER RABOBANK HONG KONG
CO-ARRANGERS AND UNDERWRITERS INTERNATIONAL BANK OF ASIA AND
NANYANG COMMERCIAL BANK.
MGT LEVELS AND FEES
LEAD MANAGERS HK$60 MLN+ 80BP ALL-IN 270.00
CO-LEAD MGRS HK$40-59 MLN 65BP ALL-IN 266.25
MANAGERS HK$20-39 MLN 50BP ALL-IN 262.50
--Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6960
